questions.answer:
First, calculate the tuition:
\[ 15 \text{ credits} \times \$435 \text{ per credit} = \$6,525 \]

Next, calculate the fees:
- Technology fee: \( 150 \text{ credits} \times \$110 \text{ per quarter} = \$16,500 \)
- Lab fee: \( 2 \text{ courses} \times \$75 \text{ per lab course} = \$150 \)
- GPU compute fee: \( 15 \text{ credits} \times \$40 \text{ per quarter} = \$600 \)

Total fees:
\[ \$16,500 + \$150 + \$600 = \$17,250 \]

Total tuition plus fees:
\[ \$6,525 + \$17,250 = \$23,775 \]

The total for tuition plus all fees in Fall 2025 is \$23,775. [fin-tuition-2025-26]
